description: A proprietary blend ingredient listed on a dietary supplement label without a full per-ingredient quantity breakdown.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: NHANES blend ingredient identifier (DSDIID), represented with the nhanes: prefix, for example nhanes:536.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Blend ingredient name from the product label, stored in title case.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the blend record; includes NHANES.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time when the blend record was created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Proprietary blend entries in the Dietary Supplement Database Ingredient Information file (DSII), covering dietary supplement ingredients reported by NHANES participants from 1999 onward. Discrete ingredients with known quantities are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Published by the CDC’s National Center for Health Statistics, DSII identifies blend ingredients by DSDIID. A blend can appear in multiple supplement products. Blend nodes do not include product-specific blend quantities or units.
